plugin.name: Clickland
plugin.description: Clickland observability: search logs and traces, services, metrics, log patterns, alerts, notes, knowledge search and views, an alert webhook trigger and a polling trigger; reachable over HTTP, gRPC, any installed broker and MCP
plugin.author: Landflow

nodes.name: clickland
nodes.description: Search logs and traces, read services, metrics and log patterns, manage alerts, add and search notes, ask the knowledge search and render views in Clickland
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}
nodes.toolDescription: Clickland observability: search logs and traces with Clickland's query language, read one trace, list services with their error rate and latency, list and query metrics, find log patterns, list alerts and their events, create or change alerts, add and search notes, search Clickland's knowledge (notes, alert events, patterns, services) and render views (charts, tables, traces) that show inline in Clickland's console.

options.name: Search
options.description: Log rows matching a query, newest first

options.name: Histogram
options.description: Matching rows counted per time bucket, optionally per value of a field (at most 10 series)

options.name: Patterns
options.description: The templates the matching log lines follow (Drain over a sample), with counts and an example

options.name: Search
options.description: Spans matching a query, newest first

options.name: Get
options.description: Every span of one trace, sorted by start time

options.name: List

properties.name: spec
properties.description: A Clickland view as JSON: { title, description?, range, panels } with up to 12 panels. range: { "lastMinutes": n } (relative, refreshes) or { "from", "to" } (ISO 8601). Every panel has type, title and optional width "half" (default) or "full". Panel types: timeseries { signal: "logs"|"traces", query, groupBy? } counts over time; metric { metric, metricType: "gauge"|"sum"|"histogram", aggregation: "avg"|"min"|"max"|"sum"|"rate"|"p50"|"p95"|"p99", service?, groupBy? }; stat { signal, query } one count; logs { query, limit? } matching log rows; spans { query, limit? } matching spans; trace { traceId } one trace as a waterfall; services {} request rate, errors and latency per service; patterns { query } log templates (Drain); markdown { text } a finding in words. nodes.name: clicklandAlertTrigger
nodes.description: Starts the workflow when a Clickland alert fires or resolves (a signed webhook Clickland sends; registered on publish)
nodes.subtitle: {{events}}

properties.name: notice
properties.displayName: Publishing the workflow subscribes it in Clickland (POST /api/webhooks; the API key needs webhooks:write) and keeps the signing secret for you; unpublishing deletes the subscription. Clickland must reach Landflow at the published URL (LANDFLOW_PUBLIC_URL). Every delivery is checked against its Standard Webhooks signature.

options.name: Alert Firing
options.description: A group of an alert went from ok to firing

options.name: Alert Resolved
options.description: A firing group went back to ok

properties.name: alertId
properties.description: Only this alert (empty: every alert)

values.name: tolerance
values.description: How far the signed webhook-timestamp may be from now before the call is rejected as a replay

nodes.name: clicklandTrigger
nodes.description: Starts the workflow on new Clickland alert events (fired or resolved) and, optionally, new notes. Polls the Clickland API: no public URL needed
nodes.subtitle: every {{pollInterval}}s

properties.name: pollInterval
properties.description: How often to check for new events while the workflow is active

options.name: New Alert Event
options.description: An alert group fired or resolved

options.name: New Note
options.description: Someone (or an agent) added a note

properties.name: notice
properties.displayName: The first poll sets a baseline and emits nothing. Events are read for at most 25 alerts per poll (the most recently changed first). Execute in the editor shows up to 5 recent items and changes nothing. For instant delivery use the Clickland Alert Trigger.

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.description: Clickland's API. On the OrbStack cluster the default; on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4710

properties.name: apiKey
properties.description: A Clickland API key (ck_…). Scopes: read for searches; alerts:write, webhooks:write (the Alert Trigger) and notes:write for the writes
